licences.notes: Words as printed in the Schirmer vocal score (Lascierò, straziar mi il crine, in contento, and Masétto with the print's accent in bar 47; the libretto has Lascerò, straziarmi and Masetto).

licences.source: G. Schirmer vocal score, New York 1900 (plate 15147, IMSLP #68957), pages 106–110, bars 1–101 of No. 12
licences.author: G. Schirmer, piano reduction as printed
licences.notes: Written out from the printed pages: the sung line and the piano each read by two independent readers, every disagreement settled on the page by a judge, then checked bar by bar and checked again by a fresh checker. The English singing translation and the stage directions are left out; Masetto is on stage but does not sing. Bar 1 is Zerlina's one-quarter upbeat and bar 61 a one-quarter bar with the fermatas; the Allegro starts with a three-eighth upbeat bar (bar 62). In bars 53–58 the piano's pairs of 64th notes in the trill figures are written so that each figure fills its sixteenth exactly. Playback tempo: Andante grazioso ♩ = 47, Allegro ♩ = 94 (a dotted quarter ≈ 63), about 3:49, from the median (3:51) of five complete recordings (Fricsay 1958 3:37, Giulini 1959 3:46, Böhm 1977 3:59, Haitink 1984 3:51, Karajan 1985 3:58); the tracks are not split at the Allegro, so its eighth note is set to the Andante's sixteenth. Mozart gives the words only.
